seoTitle: Events & Special Cruises Manchester — Music, Party & Family Cruises
seoDescription: Event cruises on the Manchester Ship Canal — live music tribute nights, boat parties, Christmas and Santa cruises, kids events and seasonal specials. Licensed bar onboard. Book direct.
heading: Events & Special Cruises
intro: Live music, party nights and family events on the Manchester Ship Canal.

sections.heading: Upcoming events
body: New event cruises are added throughout the year. See the full What's On listing for live dates, times and availability across every event.

sections.heading: Want the whole boat?
body: Hire a boat exclusively for your own event — private parties, celebrations and corporate occasions, tailored around you.

cards.name: Live Music Nights
cards.desc: Live tribute and themed nights — ABBA, Elvis, Dolly, Adele, Diana Ross, Soul and more.

cards.name: DJ Events
cards.desc: DJ-led party cruises — Boat Tropicana and Back to the 90s in the evening, Decks on Deck in the daytime.

cards.name: Family Events
cards.desc: Family adventures afloat — Pirates & Mermaids and cruises with Father Christmas.

cards.name: Christmas on the water
cards.desc: Festive party nights and seasonal cruises through November, December and January.

cards.name: Santa Cruise
cards.desc: A magical festive cruise with a visit from Father Christmas — a family favourite.

cards.name: Seasonal Specials
cards.desc: Occasion cruises through the year — Mother's Day and Father's Day.

cards.name: Book your tickets
cards.desc: Choose your event and date and book direct for the latest availability.

cards.name: Arrive 15 minutes early
cards.desc: Come to the Millennium Footbridge boarding point at Salford Quays in good time to board.

cards.name: Enjoy the cruise
cards.desc: Most events last approximately 2 hours (TBC), with a licensed bar onboard throughout.

items.question: Are there age restrictions?
items.answer: Some evening party and music cruises are over-18s, while kids and family events are all ages. Age restrictions are shown on each event. (TBC)

items.question: Is there a dress code?
items.answer: There is no formal dress code — come as you are, though some themed nights are more fun in costume. (TBC)

items.question: What's included in the ticket?
items.answer: Your ticket includes the cruise and the event/entertainment. Food and drinks are available to buy onboard unless stated otherwise. (TBC)

items.question: How much are drinks at the bar?
items.answer: A fully licensed bar is onboard every event cruise. Bar prices TBC.

items.question: Are the boats accessible?
items.answer: Accessibility varies by vessel — please see our accessibility page or contact us before booking. (TBC)

items.question: Can I make a group booking?
items.answer: Yes — we welcome groups for events. For larger groups, exclusive private hire may suit you better. Group booking details TBC.
